Blue.name: Dead-Eye Socket
Blue.flavor: Pulled it out of something that never blinked first. Screwed in backwards, it still finds the soft parts before you do.

Blue.name: Borrowed Iris
Blue.flavor: Stared at you from a dead thing's face. Now it stares at your dinner instead.
Blue.attach: set into the outer edge of the brow ridge

Blue.name: Twitch-Nerve Bundle
Blue.flavor: Still firing after the rest of the leg gave up. Grafted on, it fires yours too.

Blue.name: Coiled Tendon Strap
Blue.flavor: Wound tight enough to snap a lesser spine. Yours holds. Barely.

Blue.name: Stubborn Hide Chunk
Blue.flavor: Ripped off something that would not lie down. Bolted on, it keeps you upright a beat longer than you deserve.

Blue.name: Dead Skin Flap
Blue.flavor: Smells like nothing because it used to be nobody. Drape it on and the world agrees.

Blue.name: Moth-Eaten Pelt Swatch
Blue.flavor: Full of holes and somehow still better than your own hide at not being seen.

Blue.name: Cracked Jawbone Chip
Blue.flavor: Snapped clean off a thing that bit too slow. Wear it and bite faster than it did.

Blue.name: Splintered Fang Cluster
Blue.flavor: A whole mouthful somebody didn't need anymore. Screws in crooked, cuts straight.
Blue.attach: jammed along the jaw hinge exterior

Blue.name: Swollen Vein Sack
Blue.flavor: Still pumping when you tore it loose. Strap it under your skin and steal its stubbornness.

Purple.name: Something's Ear-Flap
Purple.flavor: Ripped it off mid-scream. Still hears everything it shouldn't.
Purple.attach: side of the head, above the jaw hinge

Purple.name: Slit-Pupil Eye Patch
Purple.flavor: Followed you in the dark before you knew it was there.
Purple.attach: temple ridge, off the main face

Purple.name: Nightcrawler's Hind Haunch
Purple.flavor: Stole its getaway. Now it's yours to abuse.

Purple.name: Second Set of Kneecaps
Purple.flavor: Extra spring. Extra crunch when you land.

Purple.name: Dead Thing's Ribcage Flap
Purple.flavor: Ripped off something that would not lie down. Bolted on, it keeps you upright a beat longer than you deserve.

Purple.name: Puckered Throat-Skin
Purple.flavor: Tough as old rope. Rope that used to scream.

Purple.name: Moth-Eaten Hide Patch
Purple.flavor: Smells like nothing. Looks like less.

Purple.name: Stink Gland, Still Warm
Purple.flavor: Wear its stench, walk through its territory unnoticed.

Purple.name: Snapped-Off Jawbone
Purple.flavor: Still has the grip reflex. Yours now.
Purple.attach: shoulder, jaw wired to the socket

Purple.name: Twitchy Tendon Bundle
Purple.flavor: Kept it twitching after the rest gave up.

Grey.name: Iron-Hide Slab
Grey.flavor: Ripped off something that would not lie down. Bolted on, it keeps you upright a beat longer than you deserve.

Grey.name: Old Bastard's Rib Plate
Grey.flavor: Cracked off a thing twice your size that still lost. Wear the crack, keep the win.

Grey.name: Jaw of the Bigger Bastard
Grey.flavor: Still has the bite in it. Screw it on and borrow the grudge.

Grey.name: Fang-Studded Knuckle
Grey.flavor: Every notch in it used to be someone's neck. Now it's yours to grind.

Grey.name: Dead-Eye Socket
Grey.flavor: Ripped it out still staring. Bolt it on and see everything it saw, right before it stopped.

Grey.name: Widow's Nose Slab
Grey.flavor: Could smell fear from three ridgelines off. Smells like nothing now, but it still points true.

Grey.name: Stampede Hock
Grey.flavor: Tore it off something built to flatten smaller things running. Kick with it and flatten smaller things too.

Grey.name: Ash-Grey Hide Flap
Grey.flavor: Matches everything and nothing. Stand still, disappear, feel smug about it.

Grey.name: Dust-Bitten Cape Scrap
Grey.flavor: Peeled off something that was hiding when you found it anyway. Wear its bad luck.

Grey.name: Old Grey's Second Wind Gland
Grey.flavor: Kept a bigger heart pumping longer than it had any right to. Bolted on, yours doesn't quit as fast.

Red.name: Twitch-Haunch
Red.flavor: Ripped off a thing that never stopped running. Still twitching. Bolt it on and neither will you.

Red.name: Rabbit's Last Kick
Red.flavor: Kicked like hell on the way down. Strap it to your leg and steal the kick.

Red.name: Panic Gland
Red.flavor: Squirts fear-juice when you flex. Makes you run like something's chasing you, because something is.

Red.name: Lidless Eye
Red.flavor: Never blinked once, not even at the end. Bolt it on and neither do you.

Red.name: Twitch-Ear Flap
Red.flavor: Heard you coming from a mile off. Didn't help it. Might help you.

Red.name: Gristle Plate
Red.flavor: Ripped off something that would not lie down. Bolted on, it keeps you upright a beat longer than you deserve.

Red.name: Scarred Hide Flap
Red.flavor: Chewed on for years and still standing. Wear it and borrow the stubbornness.

Red.name: Ditch-Colour Patch
Red.flavor: Blended into the dirt so well the last thing it saw was your teeth. Wear it and vanish just as well.

Red.name: Cracked Fang
Red.flavor: Broke on something too tough to chew. Bolt it on anyway, it's still sharper than yours.

Red.name: Overclocked Heart
Red.flavor: Beat itself stupid trying to outrun everything. Strap it in and let it try again in you.

Yellow.name: Knucklebone Knuckle-Wrap
Yellow.flavor: Somebody's jawbone, still shaped like a jaw. Wear it on your fist and let it finish the sentence.
Yellow.attach: strapped across the forearm, over the knuckles

Yellow.name: Ripped Rib-Slab
Yellow.flavor: Ripped off something that would not lie down. Bolted on, it keeps you upright a beat longer than you deserve.

Yellow.name: Second Stomach Sack
Yellow.flavor: Doesn't feed you -- just gives the first gut somewhere to hide when it's empty.
Yellow.attach: slung off the lower back like a saddlebag

Yellow.name: Old Tusk Bar
Yellow.flavor: Ripped from something that charged first and thought later. Now you do too.

Yellow.name: Dead Eye Socket
Yellow.flavor: Still points where it's looking. Useless to its old owner, useful to you.
Yellow.attach: bolted to the side of the brow, off the main face

Yellow.name: Molted Mudskin
Yellow.flavor: Doesn't help a Brawler sneak. Helps a Brawler get close enough to swing.
Yellow.attach: draped over the back like a shed hide

Yellow.name: Second Jaw Bolt
Yellow.flavor: Two jaws chew faster than one. Neither asks permission.
Yellow.attach: bolted to the side of the jaw

Yellow.name: Boulder Hide Patch
Yellow.flavor: Peeled off something built like a wall. Now you're a wall with worse manners.

Yellow.name: Thumping Heart Sac
Yellow.flavor: Still thuds under your hide. Keeps you standing when everything else wants to quit.
Yellow.attach: strapped over the flank, beside the ribs

Yellow.name: Knock-Kneed Stomper
Yellow.flavor: Doesn't make you fast. Makes the one step you take land like a landslide.
